title: The Choir Folder Mix-Up
youtube_title: The Choir Folder Mix-Up | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Asking for a second pair of hands is a skill.
summary: At a cottage room with a long tablecloth and paper stars, a choir folders that had been shelved by the wrong color will go wrong if one person rushes. Eko and Casper split it into two slow jobs, while the baker only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
